backgrounds.name: 月泊静湖
backgrounds.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original bitmap background for a modern SSH terminal. Primary request: moonlit alpine lake at blue hour, a small pale moon low above distant low mountains, dark teal still water reflecting a broad soft ribbon of moonlight, a few gentle shoreline silhouettes at the far edges. Style: refined atmospheric cinematic landscape with subtle painterly softness, sophisticated restrained color. Composition: wide landscape 1536x1024 or 16:9, horizon in lower third, generous smooth sky and water areas through the center; recognizable lake scenery. Lighting: soft moonlight, muted indigo and blue teal midtones, visibly detailed but low contrast, calm and luminous enough to see the scene beneath terminal text. Constraints: a single full bleed image; no text, logos, watermark, interface, people, bright stars, hard white highlights or busy detail. The background must support readable white terminal text without becoming a featureless black image.
